name: Welcome to Shen'dar Village

angles.text: As a night elf, you find Shen'dar Village tied to ancient Highborne bloodlines and legacy, a reminder of the pride and arcane heritage that divided elven society.
As a mage with ties to Highborne traditions, you may recognize your lineage in the High Order. Its elders, including Rathiril Sunlance, command respect in Shen'dar.

faq.answer: You are welcomed to Shen'dar Village and introduced to its key figures and fragile peace. You meet Rathiril Sunlance, the High Order elder, and Coriella Calmbreeze at the village inn before taking on local work.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the quest Welcome to Shen'dar Village?

faq.answer: Rathiril Sunlance is an elder of the High Order who lives in Shen'dar Village. He is in the main village lodge, around the corner from the one who first welcomes you, and is a contact for those with Highborne lineage or dealings with the High Order.
Coriella Calmbreeze runs the local inn in Shen'dar Village. She offers travelers food, lodging, and supplies before they venture into the surrounding wilds.

The High Order and the Windshapers follow different traditions and ambitions, and tensions run high between them. They keep a civil peace within Shen'dar Village, but beyond its edge, conflict can spill into violence in the wilds.
faq.q: What is the tension between the High Order and the Windshapers?

faq.answer: Those descended from the Highborne have a distinct twinkle in their eyes. This arcane inheritance lets observant locals recognize the look of the High Order.
faq.q: What is the High Order look mentioned by the questgiver?

faq.answer: Civility is kept between the High Order and Windshapers inside Shen'dar Village. Outside the settlement, the peace ends, and open hostility flares away from watchful eyes.
faq.q: Is Shen'dar Village safe from conflict?

sections.body: Newcomers with traces of Highborne blood go to the main lodge to pay respects to Rathiril Sunlance, elder of the High Order. They also seek a room from Coriella Calmbreeze, the local innkeeper. Different elven factions share this haven, but their truce remains tense.
sections.title: A Fragile Hearth

sections.body: Daily life brings rooms and odd jobs, yet friction persists between the High Order and the Windshapers. In the village square, both groups observe civility. Beyond the settlement, away from prying eyes, old rivalries go unchecked.
sections.title: Rivalries of the Wilds

summary: In Shen'dar Village, newcomers with Highborne blood are welcomed under a fragile truce. The High Order and Windshapers keep peace within the settlement, while old rivalries simmer beyond its borders.
attribution: In-game quest text: Welcome to Shen'dar Village
